This 2026 Subaru Impreza Sport in striking red delivers the reliability and capability you expect from Subaru, backed by Subaru Certified Pre-Owned status and comprehensive protection.

- All Wheel Drive for confident handling in any weather condition
- Clean Carfax history
- Blind Spot Detection with Rear Cross-Traffic Alert system
- Power Moonroof with tilt and automatic open/close
- Dual-Mode Heated Front Seats
- Heated Exterior Power Mirrors
- Automatic Emergency Steering
- Emergency Lane Keep Assist
- All-Weather Floor Liners and Cargo Tray
- Windshield Wiper De-Icer
- 11.6 Multimedia Plus System with SiriusXM
- Rear Bumper Applique and Spoiler
- 18 Dark Gray Aluminum-Alloy Wheels
- Auto High-Beam Headlights with Front Fog Lights
- Exterior Parking Camera with Rear View

This Impreza Sport arrives with complete peace of mind through Subaru's comprehensive certification program. You receive a 152 Point Inspection, Roadside Assistance, zero-dollar Warranty Deductible, Transferable Warranty, complete Vehicle History, and a Powertrain Limited Warranty covering 84 months or 100,000 miles from the original in-service date. Additionally, you get a SiriusXM 3-Month trial subscription, a $500 Owner Loyalty coupon, and a 1-year trial subscription to STARLINK.

The 2.0L DOHC engine paired with CVT Lineartronic transmission and standard All Wheel Drive provides excellent fuel efficiency, delivering 27 mpg in the city and 33 mpg on the highway. This combination ensures responsive performance while maintaining the efficiency drivers demand for daily commuting and weekend adventures.

Safety features are integrated throughout the vehicle. Blind Spot Detection helps you navigate traffic with confidence, while Rear Cross-Traffic Alert warns you of vehicles approaching from behind. Automatic Emergency Steering and Emergency Lane Keep Assist provide additional layers of protection during unexpected situations.

Comfort extends to every drive with dual-zone automatic temperature control, sport cloth upholstery, and front bucket seats. The heated front seats and exterior mirrors prepare you for colder months, while the power moonroof with UV and dark tint glass provides natural light and fresh air when desired. The Subaru 11.6 Multimedia Plus System with steering wheel-mounted audio controls keeps entertainment and navigation within easy reach.

The well-equipped interior features remote keyless entry, telescoping and tilt steering wheel, trip computer, and illuminated entry for convenience. Front and rear reading lights, sun visors with vanity mirrors and lights, and an overhead console complete the thoughtful interior design.

This 2026 Subaru Impreza Sport represents intelligent transportation with advanced technology, proven reliability, and comprehensive certification backing your purchase decision. We invite you to experience this exceptional vehicle at our showroom.

The power liftgate, reclining third-row bench seat, and split-folding rear seat provide flexibility for cargo and passengers alike.

Technology features include a navigation system, SiriusXM satellite radio with traffic updates, and Nissan's smartphone integration through NissanConnect. Steering wheel-mounted audio controls keep essential functions within easy reach. Safety systems include blind spot warning, rear parking sensors, four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, and a comprehensive airbag system designed to protect your family.
